ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: The figure shows the artificial mechanical characteristics of a separately excited DC motor at different voltages, where curve 1 corresponds to the mechanical characteristic at \( U = U_N \); curves 2 and 3 correspond to the artificial mechanical characteristics at \( U = U_1 \) and \( U = U_2 \), respectively. The relationship between \( U_N \), \( U_1 \), and \( U_2 \) is ________.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The vertical axis of the figure on the right is n, and the horizontal axis is T. There are three mechanical characteristic curves in the figure that slope downward to the right. Next to the uppermost curve is marked U_N, and it corresponds to number 1; next to the middle curve is marked U_1, and it corresponds to number 2; next to the lowermost curve is marked U_2, and it corresponds to number 3. Reasoning: For the mechanical characteristics of different voltages of a separately excited DC motor, the higher the vertical position of the curve and the larger the n-axis intercept, the larger the voltage indicated. Therefore, sorted by curve height from high to low, the voltage magnitudes are U_N, U_1, U_2.

method.method_draft: First describe the right graph and select a vertical slice at the same torque T. Read from the image that curve 1 gives the largest speed, curve 2 the next largest, and curve 3 the smallest. From the text, map these curves to U_N, U_1, and U_2. Apply the DC motor voltage equation: at the same torque, higher speed implies higher back EMF and therefore higher applied voltage. Thus the voltage order follows the speed order at equal torque: U_N > U_1 > U_2.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：右侧图是电机机械特性曲线，纵轴为转速 n，横轴为转矩 T。图中有三条向右下方倾斜、近似平行的直线；最上面的曲线标注为 U_N，并标号 1；中间的曲线标注为 U_1，并标号 2；最下面的曲线标注为 U_2，并标号 3。若在右图取同一个转矩 T 的竖直截面，交点高度显示曲线 1 的转速最大，曲线 2 次之，曲线 3 最小。推理：题干说明曲线 1、2、3 分别对应 U_N、U_1、U_2。对于他励直流电机，在相同转矩下电枢电流基本相同；转速越高，反电动势越高，因此所需外加电压也越高。所以电压大小顺序与同转矩下的转速顺序一致，即 U_N 最大，U_1 次之，U_2 最小。
